card.brief: a desert sorcerer with a bronze sceptre; ranged Sun Lance, melee Dune Strike, dash Sand Step

entry.look: a lean dark-skinned man with a short black beard in a sand-coloured hooded robe over a bronze breastplate, holding a bronze sun sceptre
entry.setting: a walled sandstone training courtyard of a desert fortress with striped awnings on the walls, three wooden training dummies on round stands, woven-reed crates and square sandstone pillars
entry.lighting: Hot golden afternoon sunlight casts sharp shadows across the sand-dusted paving
entry.props: The walls become tall sandstone walls with striped cloth awnings, the ground is sand-dusted sandstone paving, the three grey dummies become wooden training dummies with linen-wrapped bodies on round wooden stands, the boxes become woven-reed crates and the tall blocks become square sandstone pillars.

ranged_attack.name: Sun Lance
ranged_attack.text: raises his bronze sceptre at {target}, golden light gathering at its head, and fires a blazing golden lance that bursts in a sharp flash on it and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.again: swings the sceptre up again and fires another blazing golden lance that flashes against {target} and vanishes at once

phases.windup: plants his feet, turns his shoulders side-on and raises the bronze sceptre at {target}, a small sun of golden light gathering at its head
phases.release: snaps the sceptre forward and a blazing golden lance of light shoots from its head
phases.travel: the lance streaks across the courtyard as a bright white-gold line trailing shimmering heat
phases.impact: it bursts against {target} in a sharp golden flash and a ring of glowing sand
phases.decay: the golden light vanishes in a split second, leaving {target} in plain view

melee_attack.name: Dune Strike
melee_attack.text: swings his glowing sceptre into {target} in a bright arc of amber light that fades at once
melee_attack.again: sweeps the glowing sceptre into {target} again in a bright amber arc that fades at once

phases.windup: steps in and swings the sceptre wide behind his shoulder, its head glowing amber
phases.impact: the glowing sceptre sweeps into {target} in a bright arc of amber light and a spray of sand
phases.decay: the amber arc fades at once
phases.recover: brings the sceptre back across his body

dash.name: Sand Step
dash.text: dashes forward low in a swirl of glowing golden sand

phases.decay: the glowing sand drifts down behind him and settles on the paving
phases.recover: slides to a stop, his hooded robe settling around him

moves.walk: walks forward with a measured stride, his robe swaying and sceptre in hand
moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with a measured stride, his robe swaying and sceptre in hand
moves.back: steps back with the sceptre held across his body
moves.strafe_left: sidesteps to the left, his robe hem sweeping the sand
moves.strafe_right: sidesteps to the right, his robe hem sweeping the sand
moves.turn_left: turns to his left, sceptre held upright
moves.turn_right: turns to his right, sceptre held upright
moves.turn_to: turns to face {target}, sceptre held upright
moves.idle: stands tall, the bronze sceptre planted at his side
